annotations.title: Check App Links / Universal Links files

description: Check a domain's App Links (Android, /.well-known/assetlinks.json) and Universal Links (iPhone, apple-app-site-association) files: each finding has a severity (ok / warn / error) and a fix. Use it when links open the browser instead of the app. It checks the files the domain serves, not how one particular phone behaves. No key needed.

domain.description: A domain such as hilltop.strait.link or shop.hilltop.example (a full URL is reduced to its host)
